target: polynomially computable exact invariant with guaranteed polynomially bounded strict descent on every nonterminal 3CNF

legend_ledger.E1_EXACTNESS: Transition preserves the exact SAT/UNSAT decision semantics claimed.
legend_ledger.E2_POLYTIME_TRANSITION: All discovery and update work is bounded by one fixed polynomial in encoded input size N.
legend_ledger.E3_POLYNOMIAL_LIVE_STATE: All active state, proof metadata, deferred debt and reconstruction information stay polynomial in N.
legend_ledger.E4_UNIVERSAL_STRICT_DESCENT: Every nonterminal arbitrary 3CNF state admits the same deterministic transition and rank strictly decreases.
legend_ledger.E5_POLYNOMIAL_RANK_HEIGHT: Rank lies in an explicitly discrete range of polynomial height and decreases by at least one per charged step.
legend_ledger.E6_EXACT_TERMINALITY: Terminal SAT or UNSAT result is exact and polynomially replayable under the stated contract.

candidate_protocol: DEFINE one exact invariant I(F) and one deterministic transition T.
PROVE E1 and E2 before any universal claim.
ATTACK E4 immediately with explicit infinite SAT and UNSAT obstruction families.
If E4 survives, prove E3 and E5 with charged accounting.
Only after E1-E5 prove E6 and end-to-end polynomial runtime.
Any failed candidate may be retained only as safe preprocessing with Legend authority zero.
